testsuite.name: com.zynergylabs.forager.app.alert.AndroidAlertDeliveryTest

testcase.name: an overriding alert vibrates the two-pulse pattern with alarm usage
an off-track alert posts the notification on the new channel with the expected title and text
a non-overriding alert vibrates with notification usage
the channel is HIGH importance, does not vibrate, and replaces the legacy vibrating channel
a denied POST_NOTIFICATIONS on API 33+ means no notification, not a crash
on API 33 and above the vibration carries VibrationAttributes with alarm usage
